G2000.et: from a compound of (1909) and sphallo (to trip)
G2000.def: from a compound of «1909» and sphallo (to trip); figuratively, insecure:--dangerous.

G2001.def: from «1909» and «2480»; to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly:--be the more fierce.

G2002.def: from «1909» and «4987»; to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally:--heap.

G2003.def: from «2004»; an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness:--authority, commandment.

G2004.def: from «1909» and «5021»; to arrange upon, i.e. order:--charge, command, injoin.

G2005.def: from «1909» and «5055»; to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo:--accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform(X -ance).

G2006.def: from epitedes (enough); serviceable, i.e. (by implication) requisite:--things which are needful.

G2007.def: from «1909» and «5087»; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense):--add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, × wound.

G2008.def: from «1909» and «5091»; to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid:--(straitly) charge, rebuke.

G2009.def: from a compound of «1909» and «5092»; properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of «2008») of a penalty:--punishment.

G2010.def: from «1909» and the base of «5157»; to turn over (transfer), i.e. allow:--give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

G2011.def: from «2010»; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power:--commission.

G2012.def: from «1909» and «5158» (in the sense of «2011»); a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian:--steward, tutor.

G2013.def: from «1909» and «5177»; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain:--obtain.

G2014.def: from «1909» and «5316»; to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known:--appear, give light.

G2015.def: from «2016»; a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future):--appearing, brightness.

G2017.def: a form of «2014»; to illuminate (figuratively):--give light.

G2018.def: from «1909» and «5342»; to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce:--add, bring (against), take.

G2019.def: from «1909» and «5455»; to call at something, i.e. exclaim:--cry (against), give a shout.

G2020.def: a form of «2017»; to begin to grow light:--begin to dawn, × draw on.

G2021.def: from «1909» and «5495»; to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake:--go about, take in hand (upon).

G2022.def: from «1909» and cheo (to pour); --to pour upon:--pour in.

G2023.def: from «1909» and «5524»; to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute:--add, minister (nourishment, unto).

G2026.def: from «1909» and «3618»; to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up:--build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).

G2027.def: from «1909» and okello (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel:--run aground.

G2028.def: from «1909» and «3687»; to name further, i.e. denominate:--call.

G2029.def: from «1909» and a derivative of «3700»; to inspect, i.e. watch:--behold.

G2030.et: from (1909) and a presumed derivative of (3700)
G2030.def: from «1909» and a presumed derivative of «3700»; a looker-on:--eye-witness.

G2032.def: from «1909» and «3772»; above the sky:--celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.

G2035.def: from «2034» and «5507»; seven times a thousand:--seven thousand.

G2036.def: a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from «2046», «4483», and «5346»); to speak or say (by word or writing):--answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell. Compare «3004».

G2037.def: from erao (to love); beloved; Erastus, a Christian:--Erastus.

G2038.def: middle voice from «2041»; to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc.:--commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work.

G2039.def: from «2040»; occupation; by implication, profit, pains:--craft, diligence, gain, work.

G2040.def: from «2041»; a toiler; figuratively, a teacher:--labourer, worker(-men).

G2041.et: from a primary (but obsolete) ergo (to work)
G2041.def: from a primary (but obsolete) ergo (to work); toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act:--deed, doing, labour, work.

G2042.et: from a presumed prolonged form of (2054)
G2042.def: from a presumed prolonged form of «2054»; to stimulate (especially to anger):--provoke.

G2043.def: of obscure affinity; to prop, i.e. (reflexively) get fast:--stick fast.

G2044.def: of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out:--utter.

G2045.et: apparently from (2046) (through the idea of enquiry)
G2045.def: apparently from «2046» (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate:--search.

G2046.et: probably a fuller form of (4483), an alternate for (2036) in cert. tenses
G2046.def: probably a fuller form of «4483»; an alternate for «2036» in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say:--call, say, speak (of), tell.

G2048.pos:
1. solitary, lonely, desolate, uninhabited
    1. used of places
      1. a desert, wilderness
      2. deserted places, lonely regions
      3. an uncultivated region fit for pasturage
    2. used of persons
      1. deserted by others
      2. deprived of the aid and protection of others, especially of friends, acquaintances, kindred
      3. bereft 1b
    3. of a flock deserted by the shepherd 1b
    4. of a woman neglected by her husband, from whom the husband withholds himself
G2048.def: of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, «5561» being implied):--desert, desolate, solitary, wilderness.

G2049.def: from «2048»; to lay waste (literally or figuratively):--(bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought.

G2052.def: perhaps as the same as «2042»; properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication) faction:--contention(-ious), strife.

G2054.def: of uncertain affinity; a quarrel, i.e. (by implication) wrangling:--contention, debate, strife, variance.

G2055.def: from «2056»; a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person):--goat.

G2056.et: perhaps from the same as (2053) (through the idea of hairiness)
G2056.def: perhaps from the same as «2053» (through the idea of hairiness); a kid or (genitive case) goat:--goat, kid.

G2059.et: from a presumed derivative of (2060) (as the god of language)
G2059.def: from a presumed derivative of «2060» (as the god of language); to translate:--interpret.

G2060.def: perhaps from «2046»; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian:--Hermes, Mercury.

G2061.def: from «2060» and «1096»; born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian:--Hermogenes.

G2062.et: neuter of a derivative of herpo (to creep)
G2062.def: neuter of a derivative of herpo (to creep); a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare «07431»)) a small animal:--creeping thing, serpent.

G2063.def: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with «2281») the Red Sea:--red.

G2064.et: middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred [middle voice] eleuthomai {el-yoo'-thom-ahee}, or [active] eltho {el'-tho}, which do not otherwise occur)
G2064.def: middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred (middle voice) eleuthomai el-yoo'-thom-ahee, or (active) eltho el'-tho, which do not otherwise occur) to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively):--accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, × light, × next, pass, resort, be set.

G2065.def: apparently from «2046» (compare «2045»); to interrogate; by implication, to request:--ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray. Compare «4441».

G2066.def: from hennumi (to clothe); dress:--apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.

G2068.et: strengthened for a primary edo (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by (5315)
G2068.def: strengthened for a primary edo (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by «5315»; to eat (usually literal):--devour, eat, live.

G2069.def: of Hebrew origin (probably for «0454»); Esli, an Israelite:--Esli.

G2070.def: first person plural indicative of «1510»; we are:--are, be, have our being, × have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us.

G2071.def: future of «1510»; will be:--shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), × may have, × fall, what would follow, × live long, × sojourn.

G2072.et: from (1519) and a presumed derivative of (3700)
G2072.def: from «1519» and a presumed derivative of «3700»; a mirror (for looking into):--glass. Compare «2734».

G2073.def: feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (5610 being implied):--evening(-tide).

G2074.def: of Hebrew origin («02696»); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite:--Esrom.

G2075.et: second person plural present indicative of (1510)
G2075.def: second person plural present indicative of «1510»; ye are:--be, have been, belong.

G2076.et: third person singular present indicative of (1510)
G2076.def: third person singular present indicative of «1510»; he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are:--are, be(-long), call, × can(-not), come, consisteth, × dure for a while, + follow, × have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, × must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle.

G2077.et: second person singular present imperative of (1510), estosan {es'-to-san}third person of the same
G2077.def: second person singular present imperative of «1510»; be thou; also estosan es'-to-san, third person of the same let them be:--be.

G2078.et: a superlative probably from (2192) (in the sense of contiguity)
G2078.def: a superlative probably from «2192» (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time):--ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.

G2079.def: adverb from «2078»; finally, i.e. (with «2192») at the extremity of life:--point of death.

G2081.def: from «2080»; from inside; also used as equivalent to «2080» (inside):--inward(-ly), (from) within, without.

G2083.def: from etes (a clansman); a comrade:--fellow, friend.

G2084.def: from «2087» and «1100»; other- tongued, i.e. a foreigner:--man of other tongue.

G2085.def: from «2087» and «1320»; to instruct differently:--teach other doctrine(-wise).

G2086.def: from a compound of «2087» and «2218»; to yoke up differently, i.e. (figuratively) to associate discordantly:--unequally yoke together with.

G2087.def: of uncertain affinity; (an-, the) other or different:--altered, else, next (day), one, (an-)other, some, strange.

G2089.def: perhaps akin to «2094»; "yet," still (of time or degree):--after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet.

G2090.def: from «2092»; to prepare:--prepare, provide, make ready. Compare «2680».

G2092.def: from an old noun heteos (fitness); adjusted, i.e. ready:--prepared, (made) ready(-iness, to our hand).

G2094.def: apparently a primary word; a year:--year.

G2095.def: neuter of a primary eus (good); (adverbially) well:--good, well (done).

G2096.def: of Hebrew origin («02332»); Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman:--Eve.

G2097.def: from «2095» and «32»; to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel:--declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel).

G2098.def: from the same as «2097»; a good message, i.e. the gospel:--gospel.

G2099.def: from «2097»; a preacher of the gospel:--evangelist.
